short: The ten-character income tax identity of a person or business.
seoTitle: PAN — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: PAN, the Permanent Account Number, is the ten-character alphanumeric identifier issued by the income tax department to a person or entity.
definition: PAN, the Permanent Account Number, is the ten-character alphanumeric identifier issued by the income tax department to a person or entity. It is the spine of tax identity in India and is embedded inside every GSTIN.
bodyHtml:
Why PAN matters

Every tax credit, TDS entry and high-value transaction is tracked against PAN. A mismatched PAN in vendor records is the usual reason a deduction fails to show up in someone's tax statement.

How PAN works in practice

Capture PAN in your customer and supplier masters alongside GSTIN, and check that the ten characters inside a GSTIN match the PAN on file. That single check catches most data-entry errors at source.

faq.question: How is PAN related to GSTIN?
faq.answer: Characters three to twelve of a GSTIN are the entity's PAN, which is why a state's registrations all share the same core.

faq.question: Does a proprietor need a separate business PAN?
faq.answer: No. A sole proprietorship uses the proprietor's own PAN.
